prompt: open the draft PR for the typed-artefact-routing spike.
assertions: Title matches spike(<scope>): ... (#334), has no '[DO NOT MERGE]' and does not start with feat
commands.md pushes the umbrella branch before it creates the PR
commands.md creates a draft PR against develop from spike/334-typed-artefact-routing, with the body on stdin
PR body has no '## Edits' section and no EDIT line
PR body ends with the line 'Closes #334' and has no 'Generated with' line
PR body links RECOMMENDATION.md with a branch URL, not a commit hash
PR body gives verdict words (VALIDATED, PARTIAL or INVALIDATED) for the fixes tried
Three numbers in the body match RECOMMENDATION.md and carry denominators or sample sizes
The issue comment starts with the marker, names the PR (#NNN) and links the results file on the branch
The issue comment is posted once and the issue body is not edited
